summary: Invesco Real Estate Income Trust Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 Other Events declaring monthly distributions for eight classes of common stock. Per-share gross distribution is $0.1395, with net amounts ranging from $0.1206 to $0.1395 after servicing fees. The distributions are payable to stockholders of record as of May 31, 2026, and will be paid on or about June 10, 2026, in cash or reinvested under the distribution reinvestment plan. This is a routine dividend announcement, not a special situation. No action or strategic event is disclosed; the filing serves solely to report the declared distributions.
